fusions.name: Hurled Boulder
fusions.desc: Hurls a boulder that deals 30 rock damage to the first enemy it meets, then bursts, hitting every enemy within 3.5 tiles for 80% of that.

fusions.name: Shard Sling
fusions.desc: Throws a jagged shard that deals 8 rock damage, rising to 1.5 times that at its full reach of 7 tiles. Also costs 4% of your maximum health.

fusions.name: Jagged Guard
fusions.desc: For 8 seconds, 60% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it.

fusions.name: Sure Footing
fusions.desc: Your armour rises by 10%, and you have 8% earth resistance.
